title: 1940s Young Woman Outdoor Portrait, Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A 1940s black and white outdoor snapshot portrait of a young woman smiling with her hands behind her back. She wears a short-sleeved dark jacket featuring structured shoulder pads, wide lapels, and buttons, styled with a iconic 1940s curled hairstyle. The background shows a grassy roadside area with power lines and trees. The back shows significant black paper residue from removal from a vintage photo album.
